title: More crash retrievals in the ocean than elsewhere

tellings.quote: by the way, Eric Davis has said there are more crash retrieval operations that have been occurred in the ocean than elsewhere.

plain: More crashed unknown craft have been recovered from the ocean than from anywhere else, according to a claim passed on by Tim Gallaudet, a retired top Navy admiral. Gallaudet says he is repeating the researcher Eric W. Davis, who in his words "has said there are more crash retrieval operations that have been occurred in the ocean than elsewhere." If true, the seas would be the main place where such recoveries happen.
